items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: And that’s what we tried to do, the three of us, Hank Jones, Barry Galbraith, Osie Johnson and myself.

ctx.x: Yup, yup, yup. That was a beautiful time.

It was what you personified, and what you’ve always been like, I tell everybody and everybody says, “But Joe Williams can sing anything, I didn’t know nothing about a key.” They were playing what tune he wants, you know. And that’s what we tried to do, the three of us, Hank Jones, Barry Galbraith, Osie Johnson and myself. We tried to play for you what you, it’s your date, we’ve got to make you sound good. That’s what a rhythm section is supposed to do. If it’s my date then I’ll tell everybody what to do. On your…

It was beautiful to see the expression on your face and Osie’s and Hank, when the new music was put in front of you. I mean like, “Ayyy, yeah, hey look what we got,” you know. Wow, like it was like somebody bought you a new gift. Cause Jimmy Jones was writing then, and—
